Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://dumka.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Dumka District Court Anusevak (Peon) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://dumka.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Dumka District Court Anusevak (Peon) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Dumka District Court Anusevak (Peon) recruitment is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Anusevak (Peon) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for the Anusevak (Peon) post in Dumka District Court.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is Matriculation (10th) pass or its equivalent from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying is between 18 years and 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Anusevak (Peon) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 18000 to Rs. 56900 per month, as per Level-1 of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Anusevak (Peon) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Screening Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application should be submitted in Offline mode by sending the filled application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Dumka District Court?
faq.answer: The official website of Dumka District Court is https://dumka.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 01/2026.
